mutants.description: the timer IRQ path allocates on the heap
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_timer_allocates : ¬ type_of% @step_preserves_no_alloc := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h ({ isa := .x86_64, fuel := 1, heapAllocs := 0, kernelCtx := ⟨0, 0, [], 0, 0⟩, irqRing := IrqRing.init 4, tasks := fun _ => ⟨0, .runnable, .none⟩ } : KernelState) (.timerIrq ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)
  revert h0
  decide

mutants.description: the syscall path overwrites the kernel canary
mutants.old: tasks := updateTask st.tasks tid { cur with lastTrap := .syscall } }
mutants.new:
kernelCtx := { st.kernelCtx with canaryLo := st.kernelCtx.canaryLo + 1 }
          tasks := updateTask st.tasks tid { cur with lastTrap := .syscall } }
mutants.witness:
theorem witness_syscall_clobbers : ¬ type_of% @step_preserves_kernel_context := by
  intro h
  have h0 := h ({ isa := .x86_64, fuel := 1, heapAllocs := 0, kernelCtx := ⟨0, 0, [], 0, 0⟩, irqRing := IrqRing.init 4, tasks := fun _ => ⟨0, .runnable, .none⟩ } : KernelState) (.userSyscall 0)
  revert h0
  decide
